### When You Long for Rest
Author: Cindi McMenamin
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/when-you-long-for-rest-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Exodus 33:14
Points:
- Facing major decisions and difficult crossroads often causes anxiety and a feeling of being alone.
- Moses felt uncertain about leading the Israelites forward, but the Lord assured him of His guiding presence.
- God’s promise of rest relieves believers from the burden of needing to solve all problems on their own.
- Trusting that God accompanies His people replaces fear and second-guessing with peace.

### Seeing God Face to Face
Author: Kim Riddlebarger
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/seeing-god-face-face
Passage: Exodus 33:18-23
Points:
- Although believers desire to see God, His radiant holiness and consuming majesty cannot be beheld by sinful mortals.
- God graciously sheltered Moses in the cleft of the rock, revealing His goodness while shielding Moses from His face.
- The invisible God is ultimately made known to humanity through Jesus Christ in the Incarnation.
- Believers hold the future hope of the beatific vision, when faith will become sight at Christ’s return.
